# MatOps

> MatOps is gym management software for Brazilian jiu-jitsu (BJJ) academies. Owners and coaches run the class schedule, students and attendance on the web. Students book classes from the MatOps app or the web.

MatOps is in an early pilot and opens to a few academies at a time. Gyms request a demo from the MatOps website. Pricing depends on the academy.

## What it does

- A weekly class schedule that the academy builds once and can print for the gym wall.
- Students join an academy with an invite link or join code. The owner approves each student before they can book.
- Approved students book and cancel classes from their phone or the web.
- When staff cancel or change a booked class, every booked student hears about it.
- Coaches take attendance, and staff keep belts up to date.
- A drop-in link lets visitors fill in a short form and book a class.

## Who it is for

- Owners and managers of a single BJJ or grappling academy.
- Coaches who teach and take attendance there.
- Students who train there.
